title: Tutorial Koftos (Greece)
channel: Hungry for Health Fit for Future

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher reads explanatory background text over slides and then demonstrates footwork slowly with a partner in a room. She also shows large group practice with music and diagrams of the steps.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Grace from Greece and the traditional dance Koftos
History and origin of Koftos from Ipiros
Group dancing in a circle with music and shouting opa
Slow motion step demonstration with partner
Music playing with static note icon

steps_taught.name: Koftos basic steps
steps_taught.description: Step sequence starting with the right leg in a circle with a sudden stop and arms up every 22 steps

what_hinders: audio voiceover is read from paper rather than spoken dynamically

quotes.text: Hello, I am Grace from Greece and I am going to talk about our traditional dance Koftos
Koftos is a dance of both men and women from Ipiros
And now we are going to show you our steps of our dance in slow motion
